name: Tallybook
description: Crafting shopping list, villager quest tracker, spoiler-free story guide, lore collection tracker, and world reference. Pin any item for live inventory-tracked counts, have fetch errands picked up and mapped automatically, and follow the vanilla story one revealed step at a time. The Lore tab counts your journal against everything this world's content hides — volumes and chapters found, filterable by mod — opens the journal on any entry, and exports your found lore as a printable book. The World tab shows every world-config rule this world runs with (and every mod, with versions); the Player tab tracks your spawn points — world spawn and temporal-gear returning point, with map markers, respawns left, and an optional distance-to-spawn HUD line — plus deaths and more. Fully client-side, works on any server, supports every content mod's recipes, errands and lore with zero compat patches.
